title: Chapter 45 Wang Shuo Vs Huang Feiguang
content:
Chapter 45 Wang Shuo Vs Huang Feiguang

He stood up, and the whole person seemed to have undergone some changes, and it seemed that nothing had happened.

"Clean up the battlefield and bury him by the way!" He ordered Gong Zheng.

"Yes."

Wang Shuo was still a little uncomfortable with his first killing.

After a while, Gong Zheng came over and said in a deep voice: "Lord, the body has been buried."

Wang Shuo nodded, and then shouted: "Let's go."

Gong Zheng followed closely and went to Huang Feiguang's hiding place.

"Huang Feiguang, if you are a man, come out, let's fight openly."

Wang Shuo roared, as if issuing a final notice.

For a long time, there was still no response.

Only a strong attack.

Wang Shuo took the lead, and the golden armor warrior had the highest attack power, so he was naturally the main force.

The durability of this stone door is not high, only 2000, but the defense is amazing. Wang Shuo and Gong Zheng's attacks can only deduct 1 point of durability each time.

The attack of the golden armor warrior was slightly higher, only 5 points, so it took a while to reduce the durability to single digits.

At this time, Wang Shuo was on full alert. Learning from the previous lesson, he directly asked Gong Zheng to hold the shield and stand in the front.

With a "bang".

The stone door was broken.

A passage appeared in front of him. Wang Shuo asked Gong Zheng to walk in front and he walked in the back.

After walking a section of the passage, he heard Huang Feiguang's voice from the front.

"Don't come over!"

The voice was a little trembling, and there was a trace of fear.

After walking forward for a while, he walked out of the passage and suddenly saw a clear view.

I saw a huge palace appeared in front of me.

The palace was majestic and simple, built according to the mountain, and it was magnificent.

The system prompted that Wang Shuo had discovered the "Dragon King Underground Palace".

Could this be the copy in Huang Feiguang's territory?

Wang Shuo had a guess. Could it be that every player's territory has a copy?

In fact, this guess is not correct. In the novice trial stage, the difficulty of the dungeon is very high. Just like Wang Shuo, if he enters the ancient battlefield without a golden armor warrior, he will basically die.

Most of the player territories are resource minerals, and there is only a very small possibility that there will be a dungeon with a high degree of danger and powerful monsters.

Huang Feiguang is very unfortunate. There are extremely powerful monsters guarding his Dragon King Underground Palace.

Huang Feiguang stood at the door of the palace and did not go in.

He once tried to explore the underground palace, but unfortunately the small animal he put in to try was torn to pieces in an instant.

He knew in his heart that there was a great horror inside.

"Wang Shuo, don't come over, otherwise I will push open this door." He showed a look of horror on his face and gritted his teeth.

He wanted to threaten Wang Shuo with the monsters in the Dragon King Palace.

But Wang Shuo didn't know!

So he didn't have an accurate judgment on Huang Feiguang's threat.

"Huang Feiguang, since we are from the same planet, I will give you a chance to fight me."

Wang Shuo had just checked his level and attributes, and he was still very confident.

Huang Feiguang used to be a dependent. He basically stayed at home playing games and neglected exercise. He had never fought with others, so how could he have any combat experience.

So he immediately became timid and refused directly: "I won't fight with you. I advise you to leave my territory quickly, otherwise I will kill you together."

Wang Shuo had a powerful puppet like the Golden Armor Warrior, so he was not afraid. He took out his bow and arrow and shot an arrow at him.

Huang Feiguang was hit directly by the arrow. After all, the distance between them was only more than 20 meters at this time, so Wang Shuo could easily hit him.

Seeing Wang Shuo take action, Huang Feiguang also became fierce. He didn't know where the courage came from, and he decided to take a gamble.

Escape into the underground palace, there is still a glimmer of hope, if he duels with Wang Shuo, there will be only one way to die.

He absolutely did not believe that Wang Shuo would fight fairly. Looking at the two helpers beside him, he was sure of this.

He gritted his teeth, pushed open the door of the underground palace, and rushed in.

Wang Shuo hesitated for a moment, and did not follow immediately.

In the blink of an eye, he heard Huang Feiguang's scream.

Wang Shuo was frightened and took a few steps back, while Gong Zheng took a step forward and took out a shield to block in front of him.

After a while, there was no movement.

Wang Shuo thought about it and decided to go forward and test it.

He ordered the golden armored warrior and Gong Zheng to walk side by side in front so that they could support each other.

When he arrived at the gate of the underground palace, he took a deep breath and ordered the golden armored warrior to step into the gate.

There was nothing unusual at this time.

Wang Shuo also stepped into the gate of the underground palace.

What came into view was a magnificent hall. On the steps in front, there was a dragon chair, and there were several chairs on both sides, which looked like a meeting hall.

The walls around were also covered with exquisite murals.

But before he could take a closer look, a black shadow came over like a ghost, and its speed was as fast as that of the golden armored warrior.

After just one encounter, Gong Zheng was knocked out of the door, and at the same time, he only had less than 100 health points left, and this was the effect of the black shadow attacking the shield.

This sudden change caught Wang Shuo off guard, and his face changed drastically.

He immediately stepped back, helped Gong Zheng up, and retreated to the passage.

Leaving the golden armored warrior behind, Wang Shuo ran a few steps. Looking back, he saw that the durability of the golden armored warrior had dropped by more than 1,000. Wang Shuo hurriedly ordered the golden armored warrior to retreat.

The group rushed out of the passage at a very fast speed.

Fortunately, the black shadow did not rush out of the passage, which gave Wang Shuo a chance to breathe.

If the black shadow also rushed out of the passage, he could only teleport to the ancient battlefield for refuge.

This underground palace was too dangerous, so Wang Shuo decided to block this passage.

After taking a breath, Wang Shuo directly sealed this passage with stone and cement mortar.

Only then did Wang Shuo feel completely relieved.

He looked at Gong Zheng's injuries again and urgently needed to replenish his health.

Thinking of the several bottles of life potion seized from Ichiro Fukuda's backpack, he quickly gave Gong Zheng the medicine, which made his health reach a healthy state, and the rest would recover naturally.

He checked the [Task] column again.

At this time, the life and death competition task was shown to have been completed.

This level was finally passed, and the territories of these two people naturally became Wang Shuo's territory.

He finally showed a satisfied smile.

At the moment when Huang Feiguang died, Wang Shuo's territory underwent a huge change.

Huang Feiguang's territory was directly merged to the south of Wang Shuo's shelter, while Fukuda Ichiro's territory was merged to the north, and his territory was directly expanded by 2 times.

Wang Shuo was not surprised by this, and discussed it with Chang Gui again, and learned the role of the Heart of the Shelter.

So Wang Shuo went directly to Huang Feiguang's shelter.

He did not intend to keep this stone house, but directly took out the Heart of the Shelter.

Soon he transferred all the supplies in the warehouse to his backpack, and then dismantled this stone house and got some materials.

Fukuda Ichiro's territory was a forest, and Wang Shuo also dismantled his shelter.
